The opening lyric note 池 starts on beat 1 of the excerpted pickup; the preceding beat and instrumental introduction are excluded. This leaves 3 beats in the first excerpt bar; the remaining 15 measures contain 4 beats each. The complete excerpt contains 76 sounding notes, 9 rests, and 63 beats. Keep the two final 1-beat rests after the last 童年 note. All 80 source pitch indices map exactly once through the documented source groups; four same-pitch source pairs are grouped in the printed ties. Raw source duration/flag fields do not determine candidate beats. Source index42 is relative high5 (G5 in the selected C4-tonic arrangement); printed high3 becomes E5 after A-to-C transposition and register selection. The A-key original does not literally print E5. The source does not identify a performer or release edition; no recording identity claim is made. Printed A key is transposed by key class+3 to C; selected tonicC4 fixes the output register. Root complete visual reading independently equals all85 candidate events; all80 source pitches accounted for. Four tied source pairs merge, source42 alone changes pitch;100BPM is an explicit performance choice.
